reverse_split: The Company effected a reverse stock split at a ratio of 1-for-100, effective June 2, 2025.
registered_capacity: The registrant may offer and sell from time to time up to $250 million of common stock and other securities.
actual_offering: The Company entered into a securities purchase agreement and agreed to issue and sell common shares for aggregate gross proceeds of $12.5 million.
warrant_convertible: The Company issued secured convertible notes together with common stock warrants exercisable for shares of common stock at an exercise price of $1.25 per share.
going_concern: These conditions raise substantial doubt about the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.
listing_deficiency: Nasdaq notified the Company that it was not in compliance with the minimum bid price requirement for continued listing.
accounting_restatement: The Audit Committee determined that the previously issued financial statements should no longer be relied upon and require restatement.
material_catalyst: The Company entered into a material supply contract with an initial committed value of $20 million.
